steps.description: USER_GUIDE_MODE flag exists in scratchpad (active + template), default 0.
When USER_GUIDE_MODE=0, no required guide steps or blocking checks in any phase.

steps.description: When enabled, canonical path docs/user-guides/US-xxxx.md per feature story.
Minimum guide schema (Purpose, Prerequisites, Usage steps, Example, Limitations, Troubleshooting) defined and testable.
Validation reports completeness; blocks with USER_GUIDE_INCOMPLETE only when enabled and sections missing.
Traceability story ID → user guide artifact; referenced in handoff/release context.
Boundaries with US-0031 enforced; user guides end-user only; no duplicate spec-pack content.
Active and template docs/commands/rules aligned for user-guide mode.
steps.evidence: template commands, runbook, README, docs/user-guides/README.md, handoffs.mdc; tests/run-tests.ps1 and run-tests.sh
